lines.en: My belly feet push against the sand.

lines.zh: 我的身体在沙上留下一道沟。
lines.en: My body leaves a groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层硬壳，蹭着响。
lines.en: My hard shell scrapes as I move.
I inch along the hot sand.
I lower my head and push rubble aside.
There are orange veins along my back.
I crawl over the red earth of the badlands.
My shell draws in and out, and I move.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块尖锐的石头。
lines.en: I skirt a sharp stone.
I drag my tail and move slowly.
I squeeze between two pieces of gravel.
I smell ore dust.
I push my feelers into the sand ahead.

lines.zh: 我的足很多，动起来很密。
lines.en: My many feet move in a dense ripple.
I roll half a turn in the sand.
I'm not fast, but I never stop.
Grains of sand press against my belly segments.
I'm sunning; my shell warms.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有轻微的光。
lines.en: There's a faint light inside me.
I wait for someone to feed me iron.
This desert is very dry.
I curl my body a little.
I dislike being flipped over.
Two short feelers on my head.
I listen to the sand shifting.

lines.zh: 喂铁以后，我会变得更强。
lines.en: Fed iron, I'll grow stronger.
I bury my head in the sand.
A white scar runs across my shell.
Is that iron in your hand?
You crouched. I'm looking at you.
When you crouch, I lift my front half.
I don't bite people. I'm just hungry.

lines.zh: 我把头举到你膝盖那么高。
lines.en: I raise my head level with your knee.
Your foot is lifting — I saw it.
The veins on my back are glowing.
You smell like ore.

lines.zh: 我转了个头，看你另一只脚。
lines.en: I turn my head to your other foot.
Your fingers smell of iron.
A dent in my shell.
I curl tight, every segment trembling.
That missed the mark and still hurt.
I slowly uncurl.
Sand gets into my joints.
I don't cry out. I have no voice.
Half my legs have stopped.
A corner of my shell is gone; I crawl anyway.
I retreat under a rock.
As long as my segments move, I keep going.
Iron! I smell it.
I crawl toward your hand.
Lower it and I can reach.
I circle around this lump of iron.
This iron is heavy.
The iron grinds loudly in my mouth.
Eat this and I'll change.
I want the iron filings in the sand too.
I curl around it to guard it.
Keep your hand still; I'm eating.
After being stepped on, I stay clenched a long while.
I roll half a turn and right myself.
My shell scraped your foot.
I loop halfway around your boot.
You nudged me off course.
I don't fear a knock. I fear being flipped.

lines.zh: 你的靴底蹭掉我一片壳。
lines.en: Your boot sole scraped a plate off my shell.
One touch and I pull my head in.
We stir up a layer of sand.
I pause, then go on.
Another one crawls in the sand too.
We touch feelers.
It taps my head with its feelers.

lines.zh: 我们一起钻到石头下面。
lines.en: We crawl under a rock together.
Our kind don't steal iron from each other.
It pushes a little iron toward me.
Two shells lean together and grow warm.
It's a size bigger than me.
At dusk we scatter.
Next time, under this same rock.
I take it in my mouthparts.
This iron is mine now.
I tuck the iron into the gaps between my segments.
I drag it two steps.
The pearl is too round; it rolls.
I push it into the sand.
I gather the drops slowly.
I measure its edge with my feelers.
I drag this along, and it is heavy work.
I stay by it and won't leave.
The iron on your belt is rattling.
First I raise my head.
One more step and I charge.
The veins on my back light up.
I'm crawling over.
The space under this rock belongs to me.
I press my shell to the sand and gather strength.
I count each time your heel lands.
I'll ram with this one.
Don't come further.

lines.zh: 我盯住你迈出的那只脚。
lines.en: I fix on the foot you are about to put down.
I rear my front half up at you.
It's still moving over there.
I go around the rock.
My feelers stay pointed at it.
The sand gives it away.
I shift toward it, step by step.
It backed off. I won't rush.
I keep watching.
My shell hugs the ground.
It's downwind of me.
A little closer and I act.
I make no call. I have no voice.
Its trail shows in the sand.
I knock your ankle with the edge of my shell.
I coil and press on it.
My teeth hook into your boot.
That one carries heat.

lines.zh: 我背上的纹亮得更厉害。
lines.en: The veins flare brighter.
It withdrew; I stay put.

lines.zh: 我甩身把沙扫到你脸上。
lines.en: I whip my body and throw sand in your face.
My shell shoves it aside.

lines.zh: 我身上的热透过壳传过去。
lines.en: The heat in me seeps through my shell into you.
The sand flies up.
The sand bulges up — that is me coming out.
The hot wind wakes me.
First I poke my head out to look.
This badland suits me.

lines.zh: 我身上的沙簌簌往下掉。
lines.en: Sand slides off my back in a hiss.

lines.zh: 我从沙下顶开一块石片。
lines.en: I shove a stone slab off me from under the sand.
I crawl slowly out from under the stones.
The sun heats my shell.
The glow under my shell shows through.
The desert is empty and quiet.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，有点软了。
lines.en: Fire softens my shell a little.

lines.zh: 落地时我整个震了一下。
lines.en: I jolt all over on landing.
Water floods in; I can't float.

lines.zh: 炸开的沙子埋了我半截。
lines.en: The blast buried half of me in sand.
An arrowhead is wedged in the seam of my shell.
Light gets into my joints and burns.
No iron, and I grow softer.
Lightning hits my shell and numbs me through.
I fall, and I keep crawling.
